title: 定语从句专项练习
passage: 定语从句专项训练：判断关系词的选择和从句类型。

questions.question_text: The book ____ I bought yesterday is very interesting.
questions.analysis: 先行词是 book（物），在从句中作 bought 的宾语，用 which 或 that。

questions.question_text: This is the scientist ____ achievements are well known throughout the country.
questions.analysis: 先行词 scientist 与 achievements 是所属关系，用 whose 表示"他的成就"。

questions.question_text: The reason ____ he was late was that he missed the bus.
questions.analysis: 先行词是 reason，从句表示原因，用关系副词 why。

questions.question_text: Which of the following sentences contains a non-restrictive attributive clause?

options.A: The man who is standing there is my uncle.
options.B: I know the reason why he was absent.
options.C: My brother, who lives in Beijing, is a doctor.
options.D: This is the best film that I have ever seen.

questions.analysis: 非限制性定语从句用逗号隔开，对先行词作补充说明。C 选项中 who lives in Beijing 前后有逗号，是非限制性定语从句。

questions.question_text: All ____ is needed is a supply of oil.
questions.analysis: 先行词是 all 这类不定代词时，关系代词只能用 that，不能用 which。
